purpose: Single authority for project progress/layer vocabulary. Only P, M, WS and training-process Stage are permitted for these meanings.

P.meaning: Evaluation/intelligence capability claim depth. Stable product semantics, not project progress.

M.meaning: Project delivery/acceptance checkpoints. A milestone may advance one or more P capabilities but never renames them.

WS.meaning: Cross-cutting engineering work organization that spans milestones and capability phases.

Stage.meaning: Versioned sub-interval/state inside a Training Episode. Stage is never a project milestone or capability maturity label.

separation_rules: P codes are used only for capability maturity/product class.
M codes are used only for project progress and acceptance checkpoints.
WS codes are used only for engineering work organization.
Stage is used only inside training/Episode process semantics.
Generic Phase/阶段 shall not be used as an unqualified project-progress label in controlled design documents.
Legacy 1A-1G and 1C/1D/1E are not current progress/layer codes.

compatibility_aliases.PHASE1_METRIC_CATALOG.json: renamed to P1_METRIC_CATALOG.json; metric codes P1-* remain canonical.
